text:
Maria (People Ops): Heads-up: Emilie (E-9842) appears to have both US and Canadian deductions on the Feb 15 payroll after she moved to Toronto mid-pay period (travel/logs show move 2024-02-10). Can @Raj (Payroll) triage?
Raj (Payroll): Can you confirm transfer paperwork in HRIS and whether she was moved to RDW-CA on Feb 10 or left on a US termination then rehired? Need employment entity before reversing taxes.
Emilie R-R: I uploaded the signed relocation addendum and transfer authorization on Feb 8. My last US desk day was Feb 9; arrived Toronto Feb 10. I also uploaded SIN via secure portal.
Maria (People Ops): I attached a redacted paystub screenshot. Quick lines: gross 3200 USD, US federal withheld $270, CA federal withheld 420 CAD, Ontario prov tax 150 CAD, CPP 80 CAD, EI 25 CAD. Payroll run id pr_20240215_US and pr_20240215_CA.
Sara (Finance): Note comp team made the Toronto offer in USD mistakenly; total comp should be CAD going forward. That may cause FX conversion in payroll export.
Tanya (Comp): Confirmed — offer was supposed to be CAD. We have an offer correction email chain; comp will update the file and inform benefits/benadmin.
Raj (Payroll): Two simultaneous items: (1) which legal employer should have run Feb 15 payroll for Emilie; (2) currency/FX handling. I won't make any journal reversals until legal confirms employer. @Andrew (Legal) can you confirm?
Andrew (Legal): Employment law memo attached — Emilie was seconded to RDW-CA effective 2024-02-10. RDW-CA is the employing entity for work performed starting Feb 10.
Raj (Payroll): OK. Plan: open ADP ticket to reverse the CAD and USD withholdings in the Feb 15 US run and reprocess under RDW-CA with T4-reportable wages. We'll also note the relocation bonus on Feb 1 was paid by US payroll — that will be W-2. Anything after 2024-02-10 belongs to RDW-CA/T4.
Emilie R-R: FYI I received net less this pay because of double withholding. If reversal takes time, can payroll provide a one-time bridging payment so I'm not short? Appreciate it.
Raj (Payroll): Yes — we'll request an interim gross-up/advance if the reversal can't be completed before next pay date. Also need SIN confirmation sent via secure form (you already did) and proof of PR status.
Payroll Bot: Ticket PAY-9472 created, assigned to raj-payroll. SLA 48h. ADP contact: adp-ops@adp.example. ETA for response: 2024-02-20.
Maria (People Ops): Please add a note into the HRIS transfer record summarizing tax reversal steps and the ticket link for audit. Also attach the offer correction and comp confirmation once Tanya's updated it.
Raj (Payroll): Added an audit note and opened internal ticket INT-PAY-338. ADP said they require RDW-CA payroll admin signature. @Payroll Admin CA can you sign the authorization? I'll DM the form.
Payroll Admin CA: Signed and returned the authorization. ADP will queue the reversal and advise whether they will issue an adjustment or require a special run. They asked for the original payment trace and the revised pay instruction.
Raj (Payroll): Posted payment traces and requested adjusted remittance. ADP flagged that for cross-border mid-period changes we should expect both a US adjustment and a Canadian remittance correction; they'll coordinate tax remittances with tax counsel if needed.
Sara (Finance): Note for accounting: we will need FX entries and journal reclass between RDW-US and RDW-CA payroll expense. I'll prepare a memo for the month close.
Andrew (Legal): Confirming: relocation bonus Feb 1 -> W-2. Post-transfer wages -> T4. Keep records for the year-split reporting.
Emilie R-R: Thanks everyone. Please DM me if you need any extra docs.
Raj (Payroll): Will update when ADP confirms completion. :thumbsup:
